slice.name: role_local_state_reconstruction_under_exposed_chat_github_surfaces
slice.why_selected: A mechanically reproducible candidate route cannot be chosen safely until the auditor's exact current predecessor/continuation is source-qualified. The bounded state-reconstruction step therefore has highest immediate value and avoids inventing or broadening scope.

mechanisms_exercised: GitHub contents directory listing for the role-local state namespace
GitHub code search query: reproducibility_auditor continuation
not_tested: missing-tool injection against a specific candidate

observations: The role-local directory listing was reachable through the exposed GitHub repository API, but the connector response was truncated before a complete namespace inventory could be observed.
The exact code-search query reproducibility_auditor continuation returned no matching result.
Within this exact tested scope, those two observations are insufficient to source-qualify the newest role-local predecessor or continuation without additional reads or guessing.
slice.scope_guard: No claim is made that the namespace lacks newer checkpoints, that no continuation exists, or that any proposed Chat-native dependency-elimination route passes or fails.
slice.repository_transport_note: Only lightweight repository transport was used. No hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package compute, external model/API execution, protected-primary execution, or manual-user execution was used. Rate-limit exhaustion was not tested in this slice.

continuation.exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap the manifest, RUN_LIFECYCLE, DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE. Then use the first role-local reconstruction read on exact path research_audits/reproducibility/LATEST.json; if and only if that exact path is absent, use the next bounded reconstruction read on research_audits/reproducibility/STATE.json. If neither path exists, source-qualify the newest immutable role-local checkpoint with one bounded GitHub tree/search method that returns an exact path/blob. Do not mechanically replay a candidate until its predecessor/continuation identity is exact. Once exact, execute one candidate reproduction condition only and persist/read back the result.
